errors.evidence: The y-axis labels are at 1000, 1150, 1300, 1450, and 1600. This indicates a tick interval of 150, not 100.
There is a typo in the description of the legend label. The correct label is "去除偏误" (bias removed), not "去除偏偏误".

errors.text_span: 从B2到C2呈相对稳定的趋势
errors.evidence: The red line shows a steep increase from B2 (1248) to C2 (1563), especially from C1 (1306) to C2. This is not a "relatively stable trend".
There is a typo and an omission in the description of the legend label. The correct label is "未去除偏误" (bias not removed), not "未去偏偏误".
The blue line increases from a value of 1193 at A1 to 1244 at A2. It does not decrease.
The point at C1 (value 1342) is not a peak, as the line continues to rise to a higher value of 1563 at C2.
The description of the blue line's trend from A2 to C2 is incomplete and misleading. It omits the dip in value that occurs from A2 (1244) to B1 (1225) before rising again.
